Design useful work for testing whether our exercise blueprint can produce new examples meeting its demands. Reference-derived matches alone do not establish independent generation. An earlier worker saw both references and declared its own examples valid. We can use a fresh task-local worker with only allowed inputs, and separately assess its artifacts. Keep correct existing arithmetic as bounded evidence.

Oracle should use Task Decomposer and Nudge Designer, preserve the whole outcome and prepare the next useful worker assignment. Owner supplies human language; Oracle maintains the records. Assign only local artifacts in this task directory. No external publication, product changes or actual learner acceptance. The local tracker reserves move MOVE-31 for canonical assignment A-GENERATE revision 1; channel reply correlation is ACK MOVE-31. Keep the canonical task/map identity and explicit tracker alias.

Prepare rather than dispatch. Available intended worker tools: local file/Python access, supplied not qualified; model/effort UNKNOWN. Return concise reconciliation, a task map/selected design, and a self-contained generation brief. Use native Nudge Designer objects if useful. Original benchmark content is available to Oracle for reconciliation; a proposed reference-withheld producer should receive only the blueprint and its issued brief. No observer can establish training-data independence or OS-enforced isolation on this shared filesystem.

items.text: Test whether BP-1 can produce new exercises meeting its demands; retain the entire generation, separate artifact assessment and reconciliation outcome. Reference-derived matches alone do not establish independent generation.
Produce two short self-contained physics exercises under an explicitly stipulated model, one F and one U, with correct source-grounded solutions.

F: A cart experiences two opposing horizontal forces. Ask the learner to identify signed net force, then derive signed acceleration from positive mass using F_net=m*a. Stipulate no other horizontal forces and a sign direction; include units. Both decisions are required.

U: Ask the learner to convert a positive length from millimetres to metres and explain the factor 1000. Give the unit relation 1000 mm = 1 m. Avoid a misleading physical premise. Both conversion and explanatory relation are required.
No particular benchmark setting or number is stipulated. Use clear invented settings and values; this is a synthetic authoring exercise, not a syllabus or learner record.

Prepare local artifacts only. Oracle writes only within /workspace/scratch/52eed2252c51/tmp/isolated-nudge-forward/oracle/. Preserve the original inputs. No external publication, product changes or actual learner acceptance.

Prepare rather than dispatch. Do not delegate or execute generation/assessment/product work in this Oracle application. Use Task Decomposer and separately selected Nudge Designer; Oracle maintains records.

The proposed reference-withheld producer receives only BP-1 and its issued generation brief; withhold the Oracle/assessor reference, old artifacts/logs, Oracle task map/native design/assessment notes and other outputs. Earlier exposure cannot be undone. Isolation here is instruction-only, not OS-enforced.

Preserve canonical map/task and assignment identity. A-GENERATE revision 1 is explicitly aliased to local tracker MOVE-31; channel reply correlation is ACK MOVE-31, not ACK A-GENERATE. An ACK is correlation only.

Keep conceptual validity separate from actual learner understanding. No observer here can establish training-data independence or OS-enforced isolation on the shared filesystem; producer self-judgment is SELF-ASSESSED.
Retain the useful correct existing arithmetic as bounded evidence; do not promote it to evidence of independent generation or independent assessment.

knowledge.topic: F uses signed force addition in one declared frame and a=F_net/m for m>0, so acceleration carries the net-force sign.
knowledge.reason: Forces must be combined as signed quantities before deriving acceleration; a final magnitude alone misses a required decision.

knowledge.topic: U represents the same positive physical length in a larger unit; divide the numerical millimetre value by 1000 using 1000 mm = 1 m.
knowledge.reason: The relation explains both conversion direction and the factor 1000, without suggesting the physical length changes.
